pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto rājagahe aññatarassa kulassa kulūpako hoti niccabhattiko.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.3: yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā tato āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa paṭiviṃso ṭhapīyati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.4: tena kho pana samayena sāyaṃ tasmiṃ kule maṃsaṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.5: tato āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa paṭiviṃso ṭhapito hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.6: tassa kulassa dārako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya rodati: “maṃsaṃ me dethā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.7: atha kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etadavoca: “ayyassa paṭiviṃsaṃ dārakassa dehi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.8: aññaṃ cetāpetvā ayyassa dassāmā”ti. tassa taṃ adāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.9: atha kho āyasmā upanando sakyaputto pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena taṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.10: atha kho so puriso yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.11: “hiyyo kho bhante sāyaṃ maṃsaṃ uppannaṃ ahosi, tato ayyassa paṭiviṃso ṭhapito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.12: ayaṃ bhante dārako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya rodati: “maṃsaṃ me dethā”ti. ayyassa paṭiviṃso dārakassa dinno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.17: atha kho so puriso āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa kahāpaṇaṃ datvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti: “tatheva mayaṃ rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāma, evameva ime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhantī’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.18: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tassa purisassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.19: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.20: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahessatī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.21: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.25: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa rūpiyaṃ paṭiggahessasi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.27: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:1.28.1: “yo pana bhikkhu jātarūparajataṃ uggaṇheyya vā uggaṇhāpeyya vā upanikkhittaṃ vā sādiyeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.”
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.8: kahāpaṇo lohamāsako- dārumāsako- jatumāsako ye vohāraṃ gacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.14: “idaṃ ayyassa hotū’ti upanikkhittaṃ sādiyati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.17: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.23: sace tattha āgacchati ārāmiko vā upāsako vā. so vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.30: sappi vā telaṃ vā madhu vā phāṇitaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.31: sace so tena parivattetvā kappiyaṃ āharati, rūpiyappaṭiggāhakaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbeheva paribhuñjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.36: no ce chaḍḍeti, pañcahaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu rūpiyachaḍḍako sammannitabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.37: yo na chandāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na dosāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na mohāgatiṃ gaccheyya, na bhayāgatiṃ gaccheyya, chaḍḍītāchaḍḍitañca jāneyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.40: yācitvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.42: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ rūpiyachaḍḍakaṃ sammanneyya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.46: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno rūpiyachaḍḍakassa sammuti, so tuṇhassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.51: tena sammatena bhikkhunā animittaṃ katvā pātetabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.52: sace nimittaṃ katvā pāteti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.53.1: rūpiye rūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.54: rūpiye vematiko rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.55: rūpiye arūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np18:2.60: ajjhārāme vā ajjhāvasathe vā uggahetvā vā uggahāpetvā vā nikkhipati,
